coverage_note: 38 files in src/js/labs/** read in full (26 <script>-included: 3 infrastructure + 23 reachable prototypes; 12 present-on-disk but never <script>-included, i.e. dead code — see C06.labs.dormant-timeline-zoom and C06.labs.dormant-unreachable). src/js/i18n.js read in full (4,241 lines, single packet). src/js/app.js, src/index.html, src/js/timeline.js and src/css/style.css read only for the preferences/Labs/bootstrap slices named in the issue's bounded ownership — NOT their full contents, which are owned by other census tasks. Explicitly out of scope and NOT repartitioned here even where their DOM anchors live inside an in-scope file: src/js/updater-bridge.js (Settings ▸ Updates tab behavior), src/js/feedback-bridge.js (Settings ▸ Feedback tab), src/js/p2p-contacts.js and src/js/project.js (Settings ▸ Collaboration tab), src/js/figma-import.js (Settings ▸ Figma tab, already censused by C05/#1040), src/js/tutorial.js (first-run/onboarding flow). src/css/tutorial.css confirmed unrelated (tutorial-module-only). scripts/assert-no-private-labs.py confirmed a false-positive name collision with an unrelated private-labs/ (Adobe AE-bridge, license-excluded) directory, not this packet's src/js/labs/. All CSS in scope was folded into the JS packet that owns each UI rather than given a separate css-only area; generic app-wide modal/form-control classes the Settings modal merely consumes (.modal-box, .pi, .pr, .pbtn, .psel, .phdr, .pl) are noted but not owned by any packet here.

packets.title: One-time sm-* → nemo-* localStorage key migration
packets.responsibility: Forward-copies every legacy 'sm-'/'sm_'-prefixed localStorage key to its 'nemo-'/'nemo_' equivalent, leaving old keys untouched. Documented (app.js:1-9) as needing to run before anything else touches localStorage.
packets.writer: localStorage (all nemo-* keys, additive copy only)
packets.public_api: none (anonymous IIFE, runs once at parse time)
consumers: implicitly every other packet in this census that reads a nemo-* localStorage key (i18n's nemo-lang, every Labs flag, nemo-shortcuts, nemo-profile, etc.) depends on this having already run
packets.oracle: none; zero test coverage (grepped tests/**)
packets.notes: Ordering-critical: this is the first statement of the first non-vendor app script (app.js, src/index.html:2300), by design. A future modularization must preserve 'runs before any other localStorage read' as an explicit contract, not an accident of script order.

packets.title: Shared window.SM namespace bootstrap and its load-order hazard
packets.responsibility: timeline.js:349 defines the shared window.SM namespace as a full object-literal REASSIGNMENT (not a window.SM=window.SM||{} merge). Because timeline.js loads after all of src/js/labs/**, any window.SM.* write those files perform at parse time would be silently discarded when this line runs.
packets.writer: window.SM (shared, multi-writer — NOT a clean single-owner packet, flagged deliberately)
packets.public_api: window.SM (shared namespace object; also ships a placeholder SM.t stub here specifically so calls before i18n.js loads don't crash)
consumers: every other file in the app that touches window.SM — in this census's scope specifically: C06.labs.settings-panel and C06.labs.float-panel, which both defer their own window.SM.afterI18n registration to the 'load' event for exactly this reason (their own header comments document the workaround independently)
packets.oracle: none; the hazard itself is undocumented in one central place (DEF-9) — three separate files independently re-derived and documented the same constraint
packets.notes: DEF-9: fragile-by-construction. If timeline.js:349's assignment style or the labs/** vs timeline.js load order ever changes, three independent files' correctness assumptions break silently (none would fail loudly). A real fix (timeline.js:349 → merge instead of reassign) would remove the need for every downstream 'defer to load' workaround, but is out of scope for a read-only census.

cross_cutting_notes: Hand-maintained parity lists drifting silently (CLAUDE.md §1 family-of-bug-#1 shape, here across a JS registry rather than layer.children readers): labs-panel.js's TOOLS/ACTIONS arrays must independently mirror which labs/*.js prototypes are actually <script>-included; one entry (timeline-zoom, DEF-1) has already drifted into a dead, silently-no-op UI row with no visible error.

Default-value hand-duplication, two independent instances of the same hazard class (CLAUDE.md §3's 'two implementations must be kept in sync' shape, applied here to JS config defaults, not Rust render functions): (a) default language — i18n.js's currentLang() ('fr') vs initLanguage() ('en', the documented deliberate default) vs tutorial.js:520 ('fr', DEF-5); (b) Labs float-panel numeric-stepper defaults — labs-float-panel.js's PARAMS, labs-panel.js's inline mkNum(...), and each prototype's own default are 3 hand-copies of the same value, one confirmed already mismatched (canvas-grid step, DEF-8).

Script-load-order hazard undocumented in one central place: timeline.js:349's window.SM={...} is a full reassignment, not a merge, so every file that loads earlier (all of src/js/labs/**) must defer any window.SM.* write to the 'load' event or have it silently discarded. Three separate files (labs-panel.js, labs-float-panel.js, and timeline.js's own later initPropsPanelCollapse IIFE) independently rediscovered and documented this constraint rather than it living in one place (DEF-9).

docs/feature-scouting.md is referenced by comment from at least 10 files across this census's scope (index.html, i18n.js, timeline-zoom.js, 9 of the labs/*.js headers) but does not exist anywhere in the current repository — either lost, never committed, or describing an aspirational process. Worth a decision (write it, or strip the dangling references) independent of any single packet.

Test/fixture coverage across this entire census area is close to nonexistent: exactly 3 narrow regression tests touch any of it (tests/performance-regressions.test.cjs — labs/timeline-zoom.js must stay unloaded; tests/project-open.test.cjs — SMLabs.resetAll() must not fire on rejected importJSON; tests/feedback-2026-08-22.test.cjs — About-tab menu routing). Nothing tests i18n.js's own functions, app.js's profile functions, timeline.js's shortcut-remap functions, or either Labs panel's rendering. engineering/inventory/SURFACES.md independently confirms zero fixture project exists yet for either the 'labs' or 'preferences-workspace' inventory areas.

known_defects.summary: TOOLS still lists a 'timeline-zoom' entry whose backing src/js/labs/timeline-zoom.js is never <script>-included (superseded by the promoted src/js/timeline-zoom.js); toggling it silently no-ops (labs-core.js's setOn hits its unknown-prototype branch) and its 'Reset Zoom' button calls a nonexistent window.SMLabs.resetTimelineZoom.
Loader comment (2313-2321) claims '3D reference … intentionally left out of this wave' while reference-3d.js is in fact <script>-included two lines later (:2341) and fully reachable/registered.

About-tab hardcoded version fallback reads '0.7.0-alpha.1', three patch-alphas behind the actual package.json/tauri.conf.json version '0.7.0-alpha.4'; only corrected at runtime when window.__TAURI__.app exists. CLAUDE.md §7's own version-sync checklist doesn't enumerate this third hardcoded location.

data-i18n key 'settingsCheckUpdates' is reused verbatim at both :1798 (#app-check-update, Tauri app-update check) and :1829 (#sync-check, team shared-project update check) — two unrelated actions in two different Settings tabs share one translatable label.

currentLang()'s hardcoded fallback ('fr') disagrees with initLanguage()'s documented, deliberate fresh-install default ('en', :4230) and with an independent third fallback in src/js/tutorial.js:520 ('fr') — three hand-written copies of one policy decision, two different literal values. Masked today because initLanguage() always runs first, but any future state.language read before that (or without window.state) would silently diverge from the documented default.

Referenced by comment from >=10 files across this census's scope (src/index.html:2313, i18n.js, timeline-zoom.js, 9 of the labs/*.js file headers) but the file does not exist anywhere in the repository; docs/ only contains FUNCTIONAL_GAPS.md.

States Labs ships '35 prototypes, off by default' and separately (line 119) presents 'Export OCA' as a rough-but-reachable prototype; in fact only 23 of the 35 registering files are ever <script>-included, and oca-export.js is fully unreachable dead code.

Canvas-grid step default is hand-duplicated 3 times and already disagrees: labs-panel.js's Réglages row uses mkNum(50,...), while canvas-grid.js itself (:13,17) and labs-float-panel.js's PARAMS (:265) both use 100 — the Réglages-displayed default is the odd one out.

window.SM={...} is a full object-literal reassignment rather than a window.SM=window.SM||{} merge; because timeline.js loads after all of src/js/labs/**, this silently discards any window.SM.* write those files perform at parse time. Independently documented/worked around in 3 separate files (labs-panel.js, labs-float-panel.js, and timeline.js's own later initPropsPanelCollapse IIFE) rather than fixed or centrally documented once.
